title: Continuously Variable Transmission
text: Push belt continuously variable transmission with independent radii control, 3 outputs; {Control mode} sets the external or internal Ideal integrated, {Maximum variator primary pulley radius, rp_max} sets the radius .08, {Maximum variator secondary pulley radius, rs_max} sets the radius .07, {Minimum variator primary pulley radius, rp_min} sets the radius .03, {Minimum variator secondary pulley radius, rs_min} sets the radius .03, {Gap distance between variator pulleys, rgap} sets the crown wheel, {Variator wedge angle, thetawedge} sets the crown wheel connection, {Primary pulley inertia, J_pri} sets the inertia, {Secondary pulley inertia, J_sec} sets the inertia, {Primary pulley damping coefficient, b_pri} sets the damping, {Secondary pulley damping coefficient, b_sec} sets the damping, {Belt damping coefficient, b_b} sets the damping, {Static friction coefficient, mu_static} sets the friction, {Kinetic friction coefficient, mu_kin} sets the friction, {Belt mass, m_b} sets the mass, {Pulley clamp force, F_ax}, {Forward inertia, J_fwd} sets the inertia, {Reverse inertia, J_rev} sets the inertia, {Forward efficiency, eta_fwd} sets the efficiency, {Reverse efficiency, eta_rev} sets the efficiency, {Reverse gear ratio, N_rev} sets the ratio, {Shift time constant, tau_s} sets the constant .01, {Output gear ratio, N_o} sets the ratio and {Output gear efficiency, eta_o} sets the efficiency. Values come from the instance.
